aiOverview.content: Alcatraz federal prison was closed on March 21, 1963, primarily due to exorbitant operating costs, extreme logistical challenges, and severe structural decay. It was roughly three times more expensive to operate than other federal prisons, costing over $3 million to $5 million for renovations. Key reasons for its closure: High Costs and Logistics: As an island, all supplies—including 1 million gallons of water per week—had to be shipped by barge. Structural Decay: Saltwater intrusion caused severe, expensive damage to the concrete and steel infrastructure. Alternative Facilities: The federal government determined it was more cost-effective to build a new, modern prison at Marion, Illinois. 1962 Escape: While the closure decision was made prior, the 1962 Alcatraz escape by Frank Morris and the Anglin brothers highlighted the facility's vulnerability. 1962 Alcatraz escape Note: The TV show "Alcatraz" (2012) was canceled due to declining viewership, not because of the real prison's closure.

Why did they stop using Alcatraz as a prison?

Why did #Alcatraz close? The cellhouse on Alcatraz was originally built by prison laborers in 1912 and served as a military prison. In August 1934, the Bureau of Prisons took over the island from the military and opened the maximum-security penitentiary, taking in men considered to be the most troublesome in the federal system. One reason Alcatraz closed 29 years later was because the structures on the island were deteriorating. James Bennett, former Director of the Bureau of Prisons, said “Alcatraz’s buildings and steel towers were gradually being eroded by the salt spray.” The harsh marine environment began to rust the steel reinforcements in the concrete. By the early 1960’s, it was enough of a problem that engineers checked the integrity of the cellhouse. The Administration determined it would be too costly to bring the island up to standard. Instead, the Bureau of Prisons decided to construct a new prison elsewhere. A new federal penitentiary at Marion, Illinois eventually replaced Alcatraz.
